tagline: Internship set-up without losing a week
housingAlert: Short stays (3 months) are expensive: ask your employer about housing support before searching.
Never pay a deposit before viewing and signing.
You will need an address to register with the commune.

tasks.title: A1 certificate (which social security applies)
tasks.description: The A1 proves which country's social security you pay into, e.g. when you are posted abroad or work in several countries. It is issued by the social security institution of the country where you are insured. If you work in several countries at once, contact the institution in your country of residence first.
steps: Ask your employer whether you are posted or locally hired
Request the A1 from the competent institution
Carry a copy on every business trip
tasks.officialSourceName: Your Europe – Standard forms for social security rights

tasks.title: Short-term accommodation (3 months)
tasks.description: Short contracts are scarce and expensive. You need an address to register with the commune.
steps: Ask the employer about housing support
Sign a contract that allows registration

tasks.title: Register with the commune
tasks.description: Register your arrival with the commune where you live. The exact rule for EU citizens and the deadline still have to be verified on guichet.lu.
tasks.todo: TODO: verify the guichet.lu page for EU citizens staying > 3 months (URLs checked returned 404).

tasks.title: Social security affiliation
tasks.description: The CCSS (Centre commun de la sécurité sociale) handles affiliation. Its 'Stagiaires et étudiants' page explains affiliation for trainees and students; the employer files the request in the holiday-job case. Desk visits are by appointment only.
documentsNeeded: A1 (if you remain insured in Spain)
steps: Ask HR whether they file your affiliation
Check the CCSS trainees page for your case
tasks.estimatedTime: Handled by employer in most cases (verify)

tasks.title: UK business trip: ETA
tasks.description: If your internship includes a trip to the UK, most Europeans need an ETA or a visa. The ETA costs £20 and covers visits of up to 6 months.
steps: Apply in the official app or GOV.UK
Wait for the decision before travelling
tasks.officialSourceName: GOV.UK – Get an electronic travel authorisation (ETA)

tasks.title: Business trip to another EU country: posting notification
tasks.description: Short assignments to another EU country can require a prior posting declaration by the employer in the destination country. Each country has its own portal.
steps: Ask HR to file the declaration before travel
Carry the A1 and the confirmation
